title: EngineerGoalGateV1
description: Gate record written by the factory-owned goal-guard extension into the OMP session directory, outside the Engineer model's write reach. The control plane verifies it against the Paperclip run row before accepting an execution; every binding field is compared exactly so a gate cannot be replayed or forged from another objective.

schemaVersion.description: Pins the document to this contract so a gate record cannot validate against a different or future shape.

runId.description: Paperclip run the gate was observed in. Compared to run.id so a gate from another run cannot be replayed.

taskId.description: Child issue id the run was dispatched for. Must equal the issue id the control plane is reconciling.

sessionId.description: OMP session id of the observed run; compared against the run row's post-run session id.

goalId.description: Native OMP goal id the guard extension observed; ties the gate to one concrete goal, not a summary claim.

goalObjectiveHash.description: Hash of the objective as held in the OMP goal. Compared with the envelope objectiveHash to detect drift between dispatch and goal creation.

objectiveId.description: Id of the authoritative objective. Compared exactly against the control plane's objective.

revision.description: Revision of the objective the goal was created from. Compared exactly so an edited objective cannot satisfy an old gate.

objectiveHash.description: Hash of the objective body. Compared exactly with the authoritative objective.

criteriaHash.description: Hash of the acceptance criteria set. Compared exactly with the authoritative objective.

goalStatus.description: Terminal goal status as observed by the guard. Exactly the native OMP GoalStatus values; the control plane additionally requires complete before promoting.

continuations.description: Count of session_stop continuation turns the guard scheduled. Non-negative so the count cannot imply budget that never existed.

terminal.description: True only when the guard observed a settled terminal state, not a turn that merely stopped.

observedAt.description: When the gate record was written; orders gates against later writes to the same run.
